language: class Solution { public boolean findTriplet(int[] arr) { HashSet<Integer> set = new HashSet<>(); for(int x : arr) set.add(x); for(int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++){ for(int j = i+1 ; j < arr.length; j++){ if(set.contains(arr[i] + arr[j])) return true; } } return false; } }
problemTitle: class Solution { public: bool findTriplet(vector<int>& arr) { // Your code int n = arr.size(); int left=0,mid,right; sort(arr.begin(),arr.end()); while(left<n) { mid=left+1; right=mid+1; while(right<n) { if(arr[left]+arr[mid]>arr[right]) { right++; } else if(arr[left]+arr[mid]<arr[right]) { mid++; } else { return true; } } left++; } return false; }};
